battle.name: 以色列—哈馬斯戰爭
battle.brief: 以色列—哈馬斯戰爭自二〇二三年十月起，成為中文維基「戰爭列表」所收錄的當代衝突。戰場中，以軍地面部隊廣泛使用「梅卡瓦四型」主戰坦克，負責裝甲部隊作戰；此型早於本輪衝突已列入以色列陸軍服役。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦四型主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦四型是以色列陸軍裝甲部隊的主力主戰坦克，位於地面作戰體系的裝甲核心，並承擔部隊防護與機動任務。

countries: 這是一場力量與手段並不對等的跨境戰爭：以色列國家與以色列國防軍是主要交戰方；哈馬斯是控制加薩地帶並實際執行攻勢的武裝組織，不能把哈馬斯寫成國家。除哈馬斯武裝部隊外，巴勒斯坦聖戰組織曾從加薩向以色列境內施射火箭，但地面戰與主要防務由哈馬斯主導。伊朗提供政治、武器與後勤協助，並於2023年10月14日直接發動大規模遠程攻擊；真主黨、胡塞武裝、伊拉克民兵及敘利亞方向武裝分別在北部、東部與西部形成牽制。美國提供防空彈藥補給與海上防衛支援，英國與法國部署防禦性海軍力量；卡塔爾與埃及則在11月推動暫停交戰。
countriesEn: This was an asymmetric cross-border war. Israel and the Israel Defense Forces were the principal belligerents, while Hamas was the armed organization controlling Gaza and carrying out the offensive; Hamas should not be described as a country. In addition to Hamas forces, Palestinian Islamic Jihad fired rockets from Gaza toward Israel, although Hamas led the ground fighting and principal defensive operations. Iran supplied political, weapons, and logistical support and directly launched a large-scale long-range attack on October 14, 2023. Hezbollah, the Houthi movement, Iraqi militias, and armed groups operating from Syria created pressure on the northern, eastern, and western fronts. The United States provided air-defense ammunition replenishment and maritime defensive support, while the United Kingdom and France deployed naval forces in a defensive posture. Qatar and Egypt promoted a temporary cessation of hostilities in November.
people: 人物層次必須分清政治責任、總參謀部與戰區指揮。以色列總理本雅明·內塔尼胡主持自10月7日成立的戰時內閣；國防部長約奧夫·加蘭特在10月22日後由伊斯卡·卡茨接替。本尼·甘茨在戰役爆發時任以色列國防軍總參謀長，負責動員與統籌，11月1日卸任後，由原南部戰區司令赫茲·哈勒維接任。加薩方面，哈馬斯政治局主席伊斯梅爾·哈尼亞負責政治領導，最高軍事責任主要歸於穆罕默德·戴夫；聖戰旅參謀長葉海亞·薩拉吉則是公開發動攻勢、承認協調角色的重要人物。公開資料無法完整還原各營、連的即時指揮鏈，因此不能把每支突擊分隊都直接歸入最高指揮人員名下。
peopleEn: Responsibility must be separated among political leadership, the General Staff, and theater command. Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu chaired the wartime cabinet formed on October 7. Defense minister Yoav Gallant was replaced by Israel Katz after October 22. Benny Gantz served as chief of staff when the war began and directed mobilization and overall coordination before leaving office on November 1, when Herzi Halevi, previously commander of the Southern Front, succeeded him. In Gaza, Hamas Political Bureau chairman Ismail Haniyeh represented the organization's political leadership, while primary military responsibility was associated with Mohammed Deif. Qassam Brigades deputy commander Yehya al-Sarraj publicly acknowledged a coordinating role in launching the offensive. Public sources do not permit a complete reconstruction of every battalion and company's real-time chain of command, so individual assault detachments should not automatically be attributed directly to the highest commanders.
kits: 截至2023年已投入服役的主要裝備包括Merkava Mk4主戰坦克，該車配有120毫米主砲，部分車輛裝有Trophy主動防護系統；步兵、作戰工程與砲兵部隊使用155毫米自走式或牽引式榴彈砲，以及履帶式裝甲工程車。空中主力包括F-15I與F-16I戰機、AH-64E長臂攻擊直升機，以及IAI Eitan、Heron無人飛行平台。防空體系由Iron Dome使用的Tamir攔截彈、David's Sling使用的Stunner攔截彈和Arrow-3攔截彈構成，反裝甲作戰則可見Spike系列导弹。海軍警戒力量包括Sa'ar 4.5型飛彈艇與Sa'ar 5型護衛艦。哈馬斯一方可由公開資料確認的裝備包括AKM步槍、PKM通用機槍、RPG-7火箭筒、迫擊砲、火箭發射器、反裝甲飛彈、商用無人機及高速海上突擊艇；並非每件武器都有足夠證據判定其確切廠牌與型號尾碼。
kitsEn: The principal equipment already in service by 2023 included the Merkava Mk4 main battle tank, fitted with a 120 mm main gun and, on some vehicles, the Trophy active protection system. Infantry, combat-engineer, and artillery units used 155 mm self-propelled or towed howitzers and tracked armored engineering vehicles. The air arm centered on F-15I and F-16I fighters, AH-64E attack helicopters, and IAI Eitan and Heron unmanned platforms. The air-defense network relied on Tamir interceptors for Iron Dome, Stunner interceptors for David's Sling, and Arrow-3 interceptors, while Spike-family missiles were available for anti-armor operations. Maritime security and deterrence were supported by Sa'ar 4.5-class missile boats and Sa'ar 5-class corvettes. Publicly documented Hamas equipment included AKM rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, mortars, rocket launchers, anti-tank missiles, commercial drones, and fast assault craft. The available evidence does not establish the exact manufacturer and variant suffix of every weapon.
tactics: 10月7日清晨，哈馬斯以多方向協同的攻勢開場：地面突擊隊越過加薩與以色列間的邊界，高速海上小艇衝擊近岸防衛，飛行器攻擊與傘具滲入同步進行，部分分隊襲擊以軍據點、砲兵陣地與指揮節點。以軍前沿部隊利用預設陣地阻滯突破，後方則部署防空系統、封閉缺口、投入預備隊，並由戰機與直升機打擊已確認的發射陣地和指揮節點。10月13日，以軍公布Swords of Iron行動；10月14日，第162師由西南側的Kerem Shalom進入加薩，第252師由北側Erez方向投入，第82師、210師與146師依序在北部、中部及南部軸線作戰。步兵、Merkava坦克、砲兵、戰鬥工程車與空中支援協同推進，透過日夜突擊、據點攻堅及地下通道搜索逐步壓縮哈馬斯陣地。10月下旬戰鬥集中於加薩市，10月27日以軍在加薩市北部實施特種部隊突擊。11月1日，以軍官方確認十三名士兵在傑巴利亞一處地下通道中陣亡。進入11月後，主要地面戰重心轉向漢尤尼斯，12月再向拉法東部接近地延伸；月底雖曾短暫停火，但部署方向並未根本逆轉。
tacticsEn: At dawn on October 7, Hamas opened with a coordinated multidirectional assault. Ground teams crossed the boundary between Gaza and Israel, fast maritime craft attacked the near-shore defense, aircraft attacks and infiltration by parachute systems occurred simultaneously, and some detachments struck Israeli military positions, artillery positions, and command nodes. Israeli forward units used prepared positions to slow penetrations while rear echelons deployed air defenses, closed gaps, committed reserves, and employed fighters and helicopters against confirmed launch sites and command nodes. The IDF announced Operation Swords of Iron on October 13. On October 14, the 162nd Division entered Gaza from the southwest through Kerem Shalom, while the 252nd Division entered along the northern axis near Erez. The 82nd, 210th, and 146th Divisions were committed in turn along northern, central, and southern axes. Infantry, Merkava tanks, artillery, combat engineers, and air support worked together through daylight and night raids, strongpoint attacks, and underground searches to compress Hamas positions. Fighting concentrated on Gaza City in late October, followed by a special-forces raid north of the city on October 27. On November 1, the IDF confirmed that thirteen soldiers had been killed in an underground passage at Jabalia. During November, the principal ground effort shifted toward Khan Younis and in December extended toward approaches to eastern Rafah. A late-month pause did not fundamentally reverse the deployment.
data: 可核對的硬資料顯示，加薩地帶南北長約四十公里、寬度約六至十二公里，是高度狹長的戰區。以軍官方曾表示已動員接近三十萬預備役人員，但這個數字是官方動員估計，並非經獨立審核的最終人口統計。前線重型裝備主要由埃拉特港送入，再經內蓋夫北部與貝爾謝巴周邊後勤節點，以受護護公路車隊分送至南部、中部與北部戰區。155毫米砲彈、Merkava的120毫米砲彈、Spike反裝甲飛彈及Tamir、Stunner、Arrow系列攔截彈均面臨持續補充需求，美國自10月下旬開始向以色列交付額外防空攔截彈，但各批確切數量沒有完整公開。哈馬斯主要依賴預先儲存的火箭、迫擊砲彈與反裝甲武器，以色列對加薩的邊境、海上與空域管制限制補給，卻沒有可靠資料證明其分散庫存已完全耗盡。11月30日上午8時，埃及、卡塔爾與美國推動的暫停交戰正式生效，12月1日即告破裂。截至12月31日，自10月7日起計已進入第86天；各方沒有可交叉核對的每日完整傷亡總數，因此不引用單一精確總傷亡。
dataEn: Verifiable hard data show that Gaza is approximately forty kilometers long and between six and twelve kilometers wide, making it a narrow and elongated theater. Israeli officials stated that close to three hundred thousand reservists had been mobilized, but this was an official mobilization estimate rather than an independently audited final figure. Heavy equipment for the forward areas was supplied principally through the port of Eilat and then moved through logistics nodes in northern Negev and the Beersheba area in protected road convoys to the southern, central, and northern sectors. There was continuing demand for 155 mm artillery shells, Merkava 120 mm ammunition, Spike anti-armor missiles, and Tamir, Stunner, and Arrow interceptors. The United States began delivering additional air-defense interceptors to Israel in late October, although complete quantities for each delivery were not released. Hamas relied primarily on prepositioned rockets, mortar ammunition, and anti-armor weapons. Israeli border, maritime, and airspace controls restricted resupply, but no reliable evidence establishes that Hamas's distributed stocks were completely exhausted. A cessation promoted by Egypt, Qatar, and the United States took effect at 8 a.m. on November 30 and broke down on December 1. Counting from October 7, December 31 was day 86. No complete, cross-verifiable daily casualty totals for all parties were available, so no single precise aggregate casualty figure is cited.
cause: 戰爭的直接誘因是2023年10月7日哈馬斯對以色列發動的跨邊界攻勢，但原因不能只歸於單一事件。2007年哈馬斯取得加薩控制權後，以色列實施嚴格的邊境、海上與空域管制；哈馬斯則以火箭、地下通道及分散式武裝回應，雙方在2014年、2021年與2022年的直接軍事衝突中已多次逼近全面戰爭。2023年7月，加薩與約旦河西岸同步升溫，區域代理人與外部力量也持續活動，使危機累積。哈馬斯公開宣稱10月7日行動旨在突破以色列安全包圍、展示境內火力並迫使解除加薩限制；其最高層是否另有推翻以色列國家體系的目標，仍有爭議，不能當作已證實命令。以色列政府則把公開軍事目標界定為摧毀哈馬斯軍事統治、解除火箭與地下通道威脅，並在加薩建立有效軍事控制；這項政治目標與後來的戰場結果並未自動結合成同一個議題。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was Hamas's cross-border attack against Israel on October 7, 2023, but the war cannot be explained by a single incident. After Hamas took control of Gaza in 2007, Israel imposed strict border, maritime, and airspace controls. Hamas responded with rockets, tunnels, and dispersed armed formations, and the two sides repeatedly approached renewed general war during direct military confrontations in 2014, 2021, and 2022. Tensions rose simultaneously in Gaza and the West Bank during July 2023, while regional proxies and outside powers remained active, further accumulating pressure. Hamas publicly described the October 7 operation as an effort to breach Israel's security perimeter, demonstrate firepower inside Gaza, and force a lifting of restrictions on Gaza. Whether its leadership intended anything beyond that, including the overthrow of the Israeli state, remains disputed and should not be presented as a proven order. The Israeli government publicly defined its military goals as dismantling Hamas military rule, neutralizing the rocket and tunnel threat, and establishing effective military control in Gaza. Those political goals and subsequent battlefield outcomes did not automatically resolve into the same political conclusion.
impact: 戰事的直接影響是以色列由邊境防衛與遠程空襲，轉為持續時間長、動員規模大的地面與空中協同戰役；戰車、步兵、砲兵、戰鬥工程和防空彈藥都需要長期補充。哈馬斯的中央指揮與部分地面部隊受到重創，車輛、通信和地下通道遭到破壞，但其火力仍能分散運作，使以軍無法僅靠封鎖一個城市就消除全部抵抗能力。10月14日，伊朗首次從本土直接以無人機、巡飛飛彈與彈道飛彈大規模攻擊以色列，使戰爭由加薩主戰場迅速擴張為多戰區危機。真主黨、胡塞武裝與伊拉克民兵分別開闢火力牽制，美國啟動Sentinel of the Guardians海上行動，派遣航母戰鬥群與防空巡洋艦，DDG-79USS Carney等艦艇執行攔截，英國與法國也部署防禦性海軍力量。區域防空消耗、補給週期與戰區指揮因此成為軍事瓶頸；卡塔爾與埃及的外交穿梭則顯示，軍事暫停與政治安排必須分開處理。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was Israel's transition from border defense and long-range strikes to a sustained, large-scale combination of ground and air operations. Tanks, infantry, artillery, combat-engineer equipment, and air-defense ammunition all required sustained replenishment. Hamas's central command and parts of its ground organization suffered major losses, and vehicles, communications, and tunnels were damaged, but its firepower continued to operate in dispersed form. Israel therefore could not neutralize the resistance merely by isolating one city. On October 14, Iran directly launched a large-scale attack against Israel from Iranian territory using drones, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles, marking the first such direct Iranian attack on Israel. The war consequently expanded from the Gaza theater into a wider regional crisis. Hezbollah, the Houthi movement, and Iraqi militias opened additional fronts. The United States launched Operation Sentinel of the Guardians, deploying carrier strike groups and air-defense cruisers, while ships such as DDG-79 USS Carney conducted interceptions. The United Kingdom and France also deployed defensive naval forces. Regional air-defense consumption, replenishment cycles, and theater command became major military constraints. Diplomatic shuttle efforts by Qatar and Egypt demonstrated that a temporary military halt and a political settlement had to be handled as separate problems.
result: 題目以2023標示戰爭，因此完整實錄採2023年10月7日至12月31日；這段時期結束時戰爭本身並未終止。到年底，以色列掌握北部加薩、加薩市數條主要走廊及漢尤尼斯周邊的封鎖與突入陣地，並維持由北向南的推進體系。哈馬斯失去部分中央通信、指揮與地面裝備，但仍可從北部邊緣及分散地下網使用火箭、迫擊砲、狙擊與小規模突擊。以軍公布多項指揮官陣亡及地下設施被毀的成果，但完整的組織損失無法公開獨立核對。11月30日的暫停交戰在12月1日破裂，年末沒有全面停火，也沒有形成政治協議。就2023年的軍事結果而言，以色列重新取得戰略主動權並擴大地面控制，哈馬斯的跨邊界攻勢則被壓制但組織未被消除；因此這不是戰爭的最終結局，而只是第一階段的年度總結。
resultEn: Because the question identifies the war with 2023, the complete chronicle covers October 7 through December 31, 2023. The war itself had not ended when this period closed. By the end of the year, Israel held positions in northern Gaza, along several principal corridors through Gaza City, and around the encirclement and penetration positions near Khan Younis, while maintaining a north-to-south operational system. Hamas had lost part of its central communications, command network, and ground equipment, but it could still use rockets, mortars, sniper fire, and small assaults from the northern edge and dispersed tunnel network. Israel announced the deaths of multiple commanders and the destruction of underground facilities, but the full organizational losses could not be independently verified in public. The cessation that began on November 30 broke down on December 1. No full ceasefire or political settlement existed by the end of the year. The military result for 2023 was that Israel regained strategic initiative and expanded ground control, while Hamas's cross-border offensive was checked but the organization was not eliminated. The year therefore ended with an interim operational balance rather than a final conclusion to the war.
